    10→        name = "Ensure WAF prevents message lookup in Log4j2. See CVE-2021-44228 aka log4jshell"

    29→                    if managed_group[0] and managed_group[0].get("name") == ["AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet"]:
    30→                        self.evaluated_keys.append(
    31→                            f"rule/[{idx_rule}]/statement/[0]/managed_rule_group_statement/[0]/excluded_rule"
    32→                        )
    33→                        excluded_rules = managed_group[0].get("excluded_rule") or []
    34→                        # rule 'Log4JRCE' should not be set to count
    35→                        for idx_excluded_rule, excluded_rule in enumerate(force_list(excluded_rules)):
    36→                            if excluded_rule and excluded_rule.get("name") == ["Log4JRCE"]:
    37→                                self.evaluated_keys = [
    38→                                    f"rule/[{idx_rule}]/statement/[0]/managed_rule_group_statement/[0]/name",
    39→                                    f"rule/[{idx_rule}]/statement/[0]/managed_rule_group_statement/[0]/excluded_rule/[{idx_excluded_rule}]/name",
    40→                                ]
    41→                                return CheckResult.FAILED

    43→                        self.evaluated_keys.append(

class TestWAFRuleHasAnyActionsDynamic(unittest.TestCase):

        test_files_dir = current_dir + "/example_WAFRuleHasAnyActions"
        report = runner.run(
            root_folder=test_files_dir, runner_filter=RunnerFilter(checks=[check.id])
        )
        summary = report.get_summary()

            "aws_waf_web_acl.pass",
            'aws_wafv2_web_acl.pass',
            'aws_wafregional_web_acl.pass',

            'aws_wafv2_web_acl.pass_managed',
            'aws_wafv2_web_acl.dynamic',
        }

            "aws_waf_web_acl.fail",
            'aws_wafv2_web_acl.fail',
            'aws_wafregional_web_acl.fail',
            'aws_wafregional_web_acl.fail2',

if __name__ == "__main__":
